arxiv-2312-14981.title: Reduction Procedure for obtaining solutions of the scalar additive Jump problem and Riemann Boundary Value Problem in vectorial Clifford analysis
arxiv-2312-14981.creator: Carlos Daniel Tamayo-Castro, Juan Bory-Reyes, Ricardo Abreu-Blaya
arxiv-2312-14981.description: Abstract In this paper, we study the existence of solutions to the scalar additive Jump problem and the Riemann boundary value problems in the context of vectorial Clifford analysis on domains with fractal boundaries. A reduction procedure is applied with great effectiveness to find the solution of the problems. Keywords.

arxiv-2502-00673.title: Retracted Citations and Self-citations in Retracted Publications: A Comparative Study of Plagiarism and Fake Peer Review
arxiv-2502-00673.creator: Kiran Sharma, Parul Khurana
arxiv-2502-00673.description: Abstract Retracted citations remain a significant concern in academia as they perpetuate misinformation and compromise the integrity of scientific literature despite their invalidation. To analyze the impact of retracted citations, we focused on two retraction categories: plagiarism and fake peer review.

arxiv-2505-22252.title: B-XAIC Dataset: Benchmarking Explainable AI for Graph Neural Networks Using Chemical Data
arxiv-2505-22252.creator: Magdalena Proszewska, Tomasz Danel, Dawid Rymarczyk
arxiv-2505-22252.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Magdalena Proszewska, Tomasz Danel, Dawid Rymarczyk. Understanding the reasoning behind deep learning model predictions is crucial in cheminformatics and drug discovery, where molecular design determines their properties. However, current evaluation frameworks for Explainable AI (XAI) in this domain often rely on artificial datasets or simplified tasks, employing data-derived metrics that fail to capture the complexity of real-world scenarios and lack a direct link to explanation faithfulness.

arxiv-2512-03091.title: Hypernetwork Theory: The Structural Kernel
arxiv-2512-03091.creator: Richard D. Charlesworth
arxiv-2512-03091.description: Abstract Modelling across engineering, systems science, and formal methods remains limited by binary relations, implicit semantics, and diagram-centred notations that obscure multilevel structure and hinder mechanisation. Hypernetwork Theory (HT) addresses these gaps by treating the n n -ary relation as the primary modelling construct.

europmc-pmc5435198.creator: Shi Y, Wardlaw JM.
europmc-pmc5435198.description: Cerebral small vessel disease (CSVD) is a very common neurological disease in older people. It causes stroke and dementia, mood disturbance and gait problems. Since it is difficult to visualise CSVD pathologies in vivo, the diagnosis of CSVD has relied on imaging findings...

pmc-10478383.title: Influences on reproductive decision-making among forcibly displaced women resettling in high-income countries: a scoping review and thematic analysis
pmc-10478383.creator: Arielle Donnelly, Greer Lamaro Haintz, Hayley McKenzie, Melissa Graham
pmc-10478383.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). BackgroundForced displacement impacts the health, rights and safety of women, which is further compounded by gender inequality. In particular, this has consequences for forcibly displaced women’s reproductive health once resettled in a new country.

pmc-10640672.title: Polyarteritis nodosa presenting as cholecystitis—a case report
pmc-10640672.creator: Osama A A Elhardello, Mohammad N Athamnah, Rajaguru Paramaguru
pmc-10640672.description: Medium and small arteries are mainly affected by polyarteritis nodosa. Lungs are spared but any other organ can be involved. Gallbladder can be part of this systemic disease. Isolated gallbladder disease is not common. The presentation of the systemic polyarteritis nodosa as acute cholecystitis is described in this case report.

pmc-11046660.title: A case of HSV2 vasculitis causing multi-territory ischaemic stroke in an immunocompetent man
pmc-11046660.creator: Okkar Kyaw, Gagira Mudalige
pmc-11046660.description: is baseline function. However, on this admission his initial MRI demonstrated new multiterritory ischaemic strokes, and further angiography showed irregularities in several vessels consistent with vasculitis. Clinically, he remained confused with fluctuating GCS, which was not in keeping with the areas of infarction. A lumbar puncture (LP) was performed which detected the presence of herpes simplex virus 2 (HSV2).

pmc-11313133.title: Ab Initio Molecular Dynamics Insight to Structural Phase Transition and Thermal Decomposition of InN
pmc-11313133.creator: Jacek Piechota, Stanislaw Krukowski, Bohdan Sadovyi, Petro Sadovyi, Sylwester Porowski, Izabella Grzegory, Małgorzata Borówko
pmc-11313133.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Extensive ab initio density functional theory molecular dynamics calculations were used to evaluate stability conditions for relevant phases of InN. In particular, the p-T conditions of the thermal decomposition of InN and pressure-induced wurtzite–rocksalt solid–solid phase transition were established. The comparison of the simulation results with the available experimental data allowed for a critical evaluation of the capabilities and limitations of the proposed simulation method.

pmc-11491844.title: Inducing representational change in the hippocampus through real-time neurofeedback
pmc-11491844.creator: Kailong Peng, Jeffrey D Wammes, Alex Nguyen, Coraline Rinn Iordan, Kenneth A Norman, Nicholas B Turk-Browne
pmc-11491844.description: When you perceive or remember something, other related things come to mind, affecting how these competing items are subsequently perceived and remembered. Such behavioural consequences are believed to result from changes in the overlap of neural representations of these items, especially in the hippocampus.

pmc-11560267.title: Phytochemicals, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities of Opuntia stricta fruits peel
pmc-11560267.creator: Wissal Affi, Abdalla A Mohamed, Neji Gharsallah, Iryna Smetanska, Lazhar Zourgui
pmc-11560267.description: Background:Currently, research is focused on therapeutic plants which are regarded as a supply of several phytotherapeutic compounds with several activities; among these plants we find cacti. Aim:The purpose of this work is to reveal the phytochemical composition and the antioxidant and antimicrobial properties of fruit peel from Opuntia stricta.

pmc-11596190.title: Alteration in the Gut Microbiota of Chickens Resistant to Eimeria tenella Infection
pmc-11596190.creator: Yu Qiao, Qian Feng, Qingjie Wang, Qiping Zhao, Shunhai Zhu, Fanghe Zhao, Zhongchuang Wang, Ruiting Zhang, Jinwen Wang, Yu Yu, Hongyu Han, Hui Dong, Alex Galanis
pmc-11596190.description: Avian coccidiosis, caused by several species of Eimeria, is a widespread and economically important poultry disease that inflicts severe losses in the poultry industry. Understanding the interplay between Eimeria and gut microbiota is critical for controlling coccidiosis and developing innovative treatments to ensure good poultry health.

pmc-11616274.title: The impact of single and multiple occurrences, as well as the sequence of occurrences, of primary gastrointestinal cancer on overall survival: a comprehensive analysis based on the surveillance, epidemiology, and end results database in the United States from 2016 to 2019
pmc-11616274.creator: Ziming He, Di Tang
pmc-11616274.description: IntroductionGastrointestinal cancers encompass malignant tumors of multiple digestive system organs in humans. Each type of digestive system cancer also contains different histological types, each of which has a distinct prognosis. The survival time of cancer patients has significantly extended with the development of modern medicine, allowing for primary cancers occurring more than once in a lifetime.

The Zn1−xCoxO NRs samples were fabricated by electrochemical deposition and given the symbols S0, S1, S2, and S3 for x = 0.00, 0.025, 0.05, and 0.30 wt%, respectively.

pmc-12851289.title: Wildfire disruptions and cancer care: A multi-institutional study of radiotherapy treatment adherence in Northern California
pmc-12851289.creator: RA Sabol, CJ Walsh, S Densley, Y Medhat, CC Baniel, A Krishna, CT Baiyee, D Meltzer, J Boscardin, A Witztum, N Pitts, AK Paulsson, JY Luh, L Zalavari, SS Yom, K Lichter
pmc-12851289.description: IntroductionClimate-driven disasters such as wildfires are increasing in both severity and frequency, posing serious threats to healthcare infrastructure, continuity of care, and patient well-being. Individuals undergoing cancer treatment are particularly vulnerable, as care often requires frequent and time-sensitive visits over several weeks to specific treatment centers—especially in the case of radiotherapy.

pmc-13406107.description: A deep learning model with an imbalanced mammography dataset can bias models toward common benign BI-RADS categories and reduce recognition of less frequent malignant or high-risk categories. To address this issue, we propose B2M (Benign Share Benefit to Malignant), a model-agnostic framework for imbalance-aware multi-class BI-RADS classification in C-View mammography.

Utilizing artificial intelligence (AI) and image processing algorithms, this work proposes a novel 19-layer Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) for accurate COVID-19 detection from chest X-ray images. pmc-13475035.title: Urological Causes Mimicking Acute Abdomen: Diagnostic Challenges in General Surgical Emergency Practice
pmc-13475035.creator: Naveen Ch, Prabhat Kumar N, Trisha C, Ramachakra Kushal Thota, Muralidhar Chinnapaka
pmc-13475035.description: BackgroundUrological disorders are important differential diagnoses in patients presenting with an acute abdomen to a general surgical emergency unit. Conditions such as ureteric colic, obstructive uropathy, acute pyelonephritis, urinary retention, renal trauma, and testicular torsion may simulate appendicitis, intestinal obstruction, biliary colic, or perforation peritonitis. This clinical overlap may delay correct diagnosis, particularly when urinary symptoms are subtle or absent.

pmc-13546643.title: Prevalence of Elevated Lipoprotein(a) and Its Association with Cardiovascular Disease in Patients with Overweight and Obesity in Argentina
pmc-13546643.creator: Ezequiel Hernán Forte, Matias Fernando Arrupe, Leonardo Bufi, Sergio Gimenez, Augusto Lavalle Cobo, Maria Gabriela Matta, Juan Patricio Nogueira, Nicolas Federico Renna, Emiliano Salmeri, Laura Schreier, Pablo Corral
pmc-13546643.description: BackgroundLipoprotein(a) [Lp(a)] is an established independent risk factor for atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease (ASCVD). Although both obesity and elevated Lp(a) are highly prevalent, their interrelationship and combined impact on ischemic heart disease (IHD) remain incompletely understood, particularly in Latin American populations.
